2607.27023.title: BayesAME: Bayesian Active Model Evaluation
2607.27023.paper_summary: Evaluating large generative models across benchmarks is time-consuming and computationally expensive. This drives the need for methods that can estimate full benchmark performance by evaluating models on only a subset of items, known as a coreset. Current literature mostly requires the practitioner to input a coreset size. However, when reliable performance estimation takes priority over efficiency, an evaluation method should also be capable of automatically determining a coreset size that reflects this priority. We introduce BayesAME, a sequential Bayesian framework specifically targeting automatic determination of the coreset size. BayesAME models performance as a random variable by defining a latent ability for each group of items sharing the same historical model performances, with a joint prior distribution encoding the belief that the target model behaves similarly to these historical models. The posterior distribution over these abilities is used to derive performance estimators, quantify performance uncertainty, and select items to add to the coreset via an information-gain criterion. The coreset is iteratively augmented until the performance estimate fluctuation and the performance uncertainty fall below their respective user-defined thresholds. We propose a multi-target extension that captures performance correlations across multiple target models to further reduce the coreset size. Through extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, we demonstrate that BayesAME consistently outperforms sequential adaptations of existing methods. Crucially, our comprehensive analysis addresses recent skepticism in the literature, establishing that non-random coreset selection is advantageous over random selection. Finally, we highlight that leveraging continuous response log-likelihoods over traditional binary scores significantly enhances estimation accuracy.
2607.27023.paper_summary_zh: 評估大型生成模型在基準測試上的表現既耗時又需要大量計算資源。這驅動了對能夠通過僅評估子集項目來估計完整基準性能的方法的需求，這些子集稱為核心集。目前的文獻大多要求從業者輸入核心集的大小。然而，當可靠的性能估計優先於效率時，評估方法還應能自動確定反映這一優先級的核心集大小。我們介紹了 BayesAME，一個專門針對自動確定核心集大小的序列貝葉斯框架。BayesAME 將性能建模為隨機變量，通過為每組具有相同歷史模型表現的項目定義潛在能力，並用聯合先驗分佈編碼目標模型與這些歷史模型行為相似的信念。這些能力的後驗分佈用於推導性能估計器、量化性能不確定性，並通過信息增益標準選擇要添加到核心集的項目。核心集會迭代增強，直到性能估計的波動和性能不確定性降到各自用戶定義的閾值以下。我們提出了一個多目標擴展，捕捉多個目標模型之間的性能相關性，以進一步減少核心集的大小。通過在多個基準上的廣泛實驗，我們證明了 BayesAME 始終優於現有方法的序列適應版本。關鍵是，我們的綜合分析回應了文獻中的近期懷疑，確立了非隨機核心集選擇相對於隨機選擇的優勢。最後，我們強調，利用連續響應對數似然而非傳統的二元分數顯著提高了估計準確性。
